items.title: Coastal Flood Advisory issued June 1 at 8:36AM EDT until June 2 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
items.summary:
* WHAT...Up to one foot of inundation above ground level expected
in low lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in the City of Alexandria and Arlington
County.

* WHEN...From 8 AM to 11 AM EDT Tuesday, especially around the
time of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tides between one half foot and one foot
above normal. The next high tide at Alexandria is at 9:46 AM and
10:26 PM.

* WHERE...The beaches from Duck to Cape Lookout.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.
